wave: TOKYO PRIORITY D CROSS-TIER HIGH-YIELD PREFLIGHT
phase: Bounded metadata re-ranking (Tier 1 dedicated-performance identities cross-ranked with Tier 2 civic-hall large/medium/small designations) and current/current-linked first-party evidence preflight only
scopeBoundary: The remaining unresearched Tokyo Priority-D inventory was re-ranked from repository metadata alone, this time cross-ranking dedicated theater/concert-hall/auditorium identities together with civic/public-hall 大ホール/中ホール/小ホール-designated spaces on equal footing (rather than treating dedicated-performance identity as a fixed higher tier), using evidence-locatability tie-break signals as the primary ordering force. Current/current-linked first-party evidence was checked for the top five ranked candidates in order. Research stopped at the five-candidate ceiling; one ADOPT was reached, short of the three-ADOPT stop condition. No two-pass transcription, source or range authoring, production integration, generated artifact, fingerprint, or production-total change was made.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires current/current-linked first-party issuer evidence that fixes, without inference, one representative configuration with a complete issuer-numbered seat set, issuer-defined row/block/floor/category ownership, a configuration boundary, and the treatment of accessibility, removable, and alternative configurations, so that an independent two-pass transcription can reproduce it losslessly. DEFER covers a missing or incomplete printed ID set, an approximate/maximum-only capacity statement, or an explicitly movable/free-seating space. HARD-CASE DEFER is reserved for an otherwise complete numbered chart whose issuer subtotal or accessibility relation alone remains unreconciled. Capacity fitting, invented seat IDs, geometry-derived ownership, configuration mixing, assigning IDs to unnumbered wheelchair spaces, and arbitrary deletion of printed IDs for accessibility reasons are prohibited. Per the current venue-source transport policy, an HTTP-only current official issuer is not by itself a DEFER/HOLD reason; HTTPS is preferred when it works, HTTP-only is recorded under an httpOnlyOfficial waiver only if the candidate otherwise reaches ADOPT, and unofficial HTTP sources remain non-waivable. The transport waiver relaxes no seat-evidence requirement.

revisedRankingRule.instruction: Cross-rank Tier 1 (dedicated theater / concert hall / auditorium; likely fixed audience seating; assigned-ticket use assumed) together with Tier 2 (civic/public hall 大ホール/中ホール/小ホール spaces with clear stage/theatrical/concert use) as equally high priority, rather than always exhausting Tier 1 first. Break ties by adoption likelihood: source-located status, likely-eligible status, a direct operator URL, a recorded capacity, and an independent named hall/theater space. Demote (but do not exclude) studio, training-stage, rehearsal, live-spot/small live-house, multipurpose-room, movable/free-seating-likely, and sub-100-seat records relative to stronger performance-hall candidates, without moving them to a separate lower tier outright.
revisedRankingRule.priorApproachDifference: Prior waves (high-yield preflight through ranked-next preflight 4) ranked only within a single dedicated-performance-identity keyword screen (シアター/劇場/能楽堂/舞台/ライブ/スタジオ/演芸場/座 etc.) and worked strictly down that list (last unopened order: 0688, 1147, 0210, 0800, then null-capacity records). This wave instead unified that screen with a second civic-hall screen (大ホール/中ホール/小ホール/主ホール/メインホール) at the same base priority, then let the existing source-located/likely-eligible/URL/capacity tie-break (already used since the first high-yield preflight) decide order across both groups together. This surfaced 大学・美術館・文化施設の講堂 (academic/museum lecture-auditorium) and civic 小ホール records that the old single-screen order had not reached, ahead of the previously-queued 0688/1147/0210/0800, none of which were opened this wave.

metadataReranking.candidatePool: 969 Tokyo Priority-D inventory records reduce to 801 with priority D, researchStatus in {not-started, source-located}, and venueSourceId null, after excluding tokyo-official-0460 (duplicate facility-space of already-produced theater-h-standard, never given a formal disposition of its own).
metadataReranking.unifiedHighPriorityScreen: Records were flagged high-priority if their normalized facility/space/display name matched either the Tier-1 dedicated-performance vocabulary (劇場/シアター/theater/theatre/能楽堂/演芸場/寄席/音楽堂/コンサートホール/オペラ/講堂/演奏堂/ライブホール) or the Tier-2 civic-hall-size vocabulary (大ホール/中ホール/小ホール/主ホール/メインホール), with both groups given the same base score. Within that combined high-priority set, records were ordered by: +50 for researchStatus=source-located, +30 for eligibility=likely-eligible, +20 for a non-null officialFacilityUrl, +10 to +30 scaled by recorded capacity. A yield penalty of -400 per matched keyword was subtracted for スタジオ/ｽﾀｼﾞｵ, 研修/リハーサル/けいこ場/稽古場, ライブスポット/ライブハウス/live spot/livehouse, 多目的/集会室/会議室/レクホール/集会所/コミュニティ/研修室/市民活動 wording, and for any recorded capacity under 100.

researchOrder.currentness: Current: the seating-chart PDF is linked directly from the live official facility page with no intermediate secondary source.
researchOrder.representativeConfiguration: Single standard configuration (通常座席), 1F rows 1-10 plus 2F rows 11-15, no alternative layout published.
researchOrder.completeNumberedSeatEvidence: Complete. 1F rows 1-8: left block 1-7 / right block 8-14 (14 per row, 8 rows = 112). 1F rows 9-10: left block 1-7 excluding printed 5 / right block 8-14 excluding printed 10, each seat marked with an X for a pillar sightline obstruction (12 per row, 2 rows = 24). 2F row 11: left 1-6 / right 7-12 (12). 2F rows 12-13: left 1-8 / right 9-16 (16 per row, 2 rows = 32). 2F row 14: left 1-8 / right 9-14 (14). 2F row 15: left 1-6 only, no right block (6).
researchOrder.rowBlockFloorOwnership: Two floors (1F rows 1-10, 2F rows 11-15), each row split into a left and right block by a central aisle under the stage; the printed diagram itself, not geometry, draws the block boundary in every row.
researchOrder.issuerSubtotalPublishedCapacity: Independently summed: 1F = 112 + 24 = 136; 2F = 12 + 32 + 14 + 6 = 64; grand total = 200. The PDF's own printed footnote states 1階136席・2階64席｜計200席, matching exactly (rangeDiff 0 against the PDF's own subtotal). The facility page's separate 1F140/2F60 split is a coarser, rounder disclosure of the same 200 grand total and is retained as a known-limitation note, not treated as a conflicting seat count.
researchOrder.accessibilityRemovableAuxiliaryAlternate: No wheelchair space is marked anywhere on the chart. The two X-marked positions (row 9 seat 5, row 10 seat 5, row 9 seat 10, row 10 seat 10 — four seats total) are printed pillar-obstruction exclusions already subtracted from the issuer's own 200 total, not removable/auxiliary seating and not accessibility-related. No alternative configuration is published.
researchOrder.httpsHttpTransportState: HTTPS works for both the facility page and the PDF; no waiver needed.
researchOrder.dispositionReason: Current official first-party evidence defines a complete, issuer-numbered 200-seat configuration whose independently summed total matches the issuer's own printed subtotal exactly, with an explicit and already-integrated treatment of the only excluded positions (pillar obstruction) and no wheelchair or alternative-configuration ambiguity to resolve.
researchOrder.nextTwoPassRequirements: A separately authorized independent two-pass transcription must independently derive: all 15 rows' left/right block boundaries and ranges; the two pillar-obstruction exclusions (row 9 and row 10, position 5 and position 10 in each) as `excluded` entries, not as a shortened range; the 1F/2F floor boundary and area labels; and confirmation that no wheelchair or alternative-layout metadata applies. No accessibility relation should be inferred.
